question_text: Explain why rendering a complex 3D scene can benefit from a GPU and substantial RAM.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Many similar pixel/geometry calculations can be processed in parallel on the GPU. RAM holds working geometry, textures and scene data. Insufficient available memory can require more transfers or constrain scene detail, so balanced processing and memory capacity matter.
